summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Power of Ten photobooth app MVP. All backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). Frontend UI loads correctly with proper navigation flow, template selection, sticker decoration, and result pages. Camera functionality shows appropriate error handling when camera access is denied.

backend_issues.notes: All 9 API endpoints tested successfully with 100% pass rate

camera_limitations.issue: Camera access denied in testing environment - expected behavior
camera_limitations.note: App properly shows error overlay and retry button when camera access fails
